firefox.summary: Firefox MV3 manifest (109+) with Gecko ID, theme API permission, SVG icon, and pure on-demand activeTab injection (no <all_urls> host permissions).

Injected on demand to render a Shadow DOM floating QR card using safe SVG DOM APIs (zero innerHTML), Firefox theme or OS light/dark contrast guard, and fresh right-click anchoring.

Scalable vector extension icon supported natively by Firefox.
Installation guide for Firefox, Chromium browsers, and Safari plus MIT attribution.
